name: Whispering Wardens Trap (CR 13)
body:
Whispering Wardens Trap
CR 13

XP 25,600

Type magic; Perception DC 34; Disable Device DC 34

EFFECTS

Trigger spell; Reset automatic (1 minute); Bypass password (DC 34 Knowledge [arcana] or [religion] check to know)

Effect spell effect (summon monster IX, summons four bone devils for 17 rounds)
